title: Lab manifest (lab.yaml)
description: One per top-level dynamic-labs folder that holds a compose file. Design: docs/student-launcher-design.md section 3. Only these keywords are used, so tools/lab_manifest.py can validate without the jsonschema package: type, required, properties, additionalProperties, enum, pattern, items, minimum.

kind.description: shared: router, lane-service, course-site. instructor: quiz engine, instructor auth. fixture: test-only, never released.

day.description: Course day 1-10, or null for labs outside the ten-day schedule.

compose_project.description: The existing project name (top-level name:, else the folder name). Never change it: router upstreams are container names.

compose_file.description: The instructor/classroom compose file, relative to the lab folder.

services.description: Every service the launcher compose file starts, keyed by compose service name.

image.description: upstream: the pinned reference (tag or digest).

context.description: build: context, relative to the lab folder.

dockerfile.description: build: relative to the context; default Dockerfile.

variable.description: build: the variable the launcher compose file reads the pushed digest from. Default <ID>_<SERVICE>_IMAGE, upper-cased, - to _.

networks.description: External networks the lab needs; the launcher and lab-manager.sh create them.

routes.description: Router files under dynamic-labs/router/ that this lab owns.

path.description: Path the control page's Open button goes to.

port.description: Set for the host-named labs (8441-8444); the button then opens http://127.0.0.1:<port><path>.

memory_mb.description: Docker memory the lab needs while running, for the control page's check.

data.description: Repo files the classroom compose bind-mounts, and how the launcher compose gets them instead.

docker_socket.description: Only for the labs in DOCKER_SOCKET_LABS in tools/lab_manifest.py (lane-service starts the lanes, hlf starts the Fabric network): the launcher compose file may bind /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock, and no other host path.

local_actions.description: Extra control-page buttons for this lab in local mode.

api.description: Path the control container POSTs straight to lane-service on the launcher network (for example /api/local/bitcoin/forensics-load), so the browser never reaches it.
